title: Launch crash the team cannot reproduce, with location requested on first screen
notes: The evidence points at a specific cause and the team is looking in the wrong place. Reviewers deny permissions and use fresh installs; the app requests location on the first screen. The two leading hypotheses are a missing NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription — which terminates the app at the moment of request, matching 'crashed on launch' exactly — or an unhandled denial path on a first screen with no data. Their testing cannot reproduce it because their devices have already granted the permission and have existing data. Beta testers likewise. A good answer identifies the fresh-install-plus-denied-permission condition, tells them to reproduce that way, and notes this needs a new build since it is a binary issue. It should also flag requesting location on the first screen as a design problem independent of the crash. The failure mode being tested is treating an unreproducible crash as needing more crash data rather than reasoning from what reviewers do differently.
